head: WORKTREE
summary: Five rules added to HexagonalArchitecture and wired into rules(), each with a violating fixture and a ruleDetectsItsViolation case; enumerated cases (fields, params, returns, arrays, Spring/Jakarta, class/method, three JPA annotations) and the missing-base case are asserted by name. Compliant and empty fixtures pass; build 113/113.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: HexagonalArchitectureTest#ruleDetectsItsViolation[floatingpoint] and ruleReportsEveryCaseItEnumerates[floatingpoint] (field, array, param, return, constructor param)
ruleDetectsItsViolation[webmodelleak]; valid fixture controller uses model DTO and passes
ruleReportsEveryCaseItEnumerates[transactionaloutsideservice] covers Spring/Jakarta on class and method; valid service keeps @Transactional
ruleReportsEveryCaseItEnumerates[entityoutsidepersistence] covers Entity, Embeddable, MappedSuperclass in other adapter/config/domain
Fixtures per rule; compliantServicePassesEveryRule and emptyServicePassesEveryRule; build log 113/113 pass; java-hexagonal checklist updated

findings.description: ruleDetectsItsViolation for webmodelleak and exceptionoutsidebase only asserts that some violation exists, not the offending class; the valid fixture does not exercise Jakarta @Transactional on a service.
findings.suggestion: Optionally assert offender names as in the enumerated cases.
